title.narrative: Crisis response for securing reliable energy access in Ukraine (FPI Energy)

description.narrative: The overall objective of the proposed project is to facilitate work by public authoritiesto ensure reliable access to electricity, heat, water supply and sanitation amid the ongoing attacks on the energy infrastructure. UNDP will build on its presence and broad partnerships on sub-national, national and international levels to ensure effective delivery and impact.The UNDP Green Energy Recovery Programme is an integrated approach to address Ukraine’s needs to accelerate efforts towards a more diverse energy mix the project herein has been designed to respond to, and align with, the specific objectives of the overarching EU Emergency Support Programme in favour of Ukraine, which will:1. Contribute to meeting the immediate needs of the Ukrainian population directly or indirectly affected by the armed conflict.2. Increase the country’s resilienceThe key objective of the UNDP-FPI Project “Crisis response for securing reliable energy access in Ukraine is to promote self-sufficiency and sustainability in energy provision, aiming for universal access for the people of Ukraine, emphasizing locally-led recovery efforts with optimal adaptation of green energy sources and technologies. Ensuring access to energy is critical to strengthen the resilience of the people and critical infrastructure of Ukraine during the war.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
